sections.sectionSummaryBrief: This section contains the opening header and date of the maamar.

translations.translation: With the help of Heaven.
Shabbat Parshat Emor,
the 19th of Iyar,
the year 5737*

sections.sectionSummaryBrief: This section explains that the verse "Gal Einai" alludes to Lag BaOmer, and that one reaches the revelation of "Gal Einai" through the concept of "Ad HaGal HaZeh."

translations.translation: "Unveil my eyes and I will behold wonders from Your Torah"1,
and the Admore"r Maharash wrote in his maamar on this verse2,
that based on what is stated in the Siddur, Sha'ar HaLag BaOmer3,
that the hint in the Torah regarding Lag BaOmer is in the verse4
"Ad HaGal HaZeh" (Until this mound),
also the verse "Gal Einai" will be explained regarding Lag BaOmer.
And based on the known principle that all matters in the Torah are with utmost precision,
it must be said,
that this matter of Lag BaOmer in the verse "Gal Einai" etc. is learned from the matter of Lag BaOmer in the verse "Ad HaGal HaZeh",
it is,
that in order to come to the matter of "Gal Einai" etc., it is through "Ad HaGal HaZeh".

sections.sectionSummaryBrief: This section explains the connection of this verse to Lag BaOmer, the day of Rashbi's passing, when the inner dimension of Torah was revealed and is reawakened each year.

translations.translation: Now, the connection of this verse to Lag BaOmer, the day of the passing of Rashbi
(simply),
is,
that the essence of Rashbi is – that through him was the revelation of the inner dimension of Torah
[and as explained in many places5,
that the revelation of the revealed Torah was through Moshe Rabbeinu and the revelation of the inner dimension of Torah was through Rashbi6],
and the primary revelation was on the day of his passing,
as it is brought in the Zohar7
that on the day of his passing he revealed to his students "sacred words" that he had not revealed during all the days of his life
(because the matters he revealed then were most sublime matters that even Rashbi was previously afraid to reveal8).
And through the writing of the sacred words
(according to his command9),
they were later revealed to all of Israel,
to the extent that they were revealed in a manner of "yitparnason"10,
in comprehension and perception.
That also the drawing down of this revelation
(the revelation to all of Israel and in a manner of "yitparnason")
was on the day of the passing of Rashbi
(through the writing of the sacred words then,
according to his command).
And to add,
based on the known principle11
that on the day of a person's passing, the inner dimension of all his service that he served throughout all the days of his life is revealed,
it is understood,
that on the day of the passing of Rashbi,
there was also revealed the inner dimension of the secrets that he revealed during all the days of his life.
And in every single year,
on the day of Lag BaOmer,
the revelation that was on Lag BaOmer the first time is reawakened12
– the revelation of the inner dimension of Torah
(the Torah of Rashbi).
And this is also understood from what is explained in many places13
that on Lag BaOmer is the giving of the Torah14
of the inner dimension of Torah,
similar to the holiday of Shavuot which is the time of the giving of the Torah in general.
From this it is understood,
that just as the giving of the Torah on Shavuot is in every single year,
so too the giving of the Torah of the inner dimension of Torah on Lag BaOmer is in every single year.
And this is that the matter of Lag BaOmer is hinted at in the verse "Gal Einai v'Avitah Nifla'ot miToratecha",
because "Nifla'ot" (wonders) in the Torah is the inner dimension of Torah15,
and the matter of "Gal" etc. "Nifla'ot" is the revelation
(Gal from the term Gilui [revelation]16)
of the wonders of the Torah
(the inner dimension of Torah)
that is drawn down in "GaL"
(on Lag BaOmer).
